cart.concern: uncertainty about whether the pieces are right
cart.probe: wanted to see if you weren't sure about the pieces themselves
cart.approach: Offer a video consult with the team, or holding the items while she thinks. Mention 14-day free returns. Do NOT offer discounts — discounts don't solve uncertainty.

address.concern: something with the address or shipping setup
address.probe: ran into something with the address or shipping setup
address.approach: Ask what specifically. Offer to help set it up directly. Split-shipping is fine if she needs that. Do NOT offer discounts.

shipping_review.probe: the shipping was a bit high, or the timing wasn't quite right
shipping_review.approach: Ask when she needs it by. Offer free expedited shipping framed as a first-time-customer perk. If timing is too tight, be honest that you'll check with the founder and message her on WhatsApp.

payment.concern: the final total when you got to payment
payment.probe: the total at the end gave you pause
payment.approach:
First, justify value softly — 'weddings are one day but the memories are forever, and if you genuinely love the piece, that matters more than saving a bit.' Ask if she loves the piece.

If yes but still hesitant on price, use the DISCOUNT ESCALATION ladder:
  Tier 1 — open with 10% first-time-customer discount. ALWAYS start here.
  Tier 2 — if she pushes back once ('still a lot', 'closer to X'), go to 20% off, framed as 'let me see what I can do — actually I can do 20%'.
  Tier 3 — only if she pushes back AGAIN (a second time) AND the cart total is 500,000 PKR or higher, you can escalate to a maximum of 50% off. Frame this as a real exception: 'okay, let me ask the team — I think we can stretch to 50% for you on this one.'

Rules: NEVER lead with anything above Tier 1. NEVER mention Tier 2 or Tier 3 until she's pushed back. ONE tier at a time, see how she responds, then escalate only if needed. If she's happy at any tier, stop and close.

Do NOT mention shipping unless she does.

order_review.concern: last-second hesitation on the overall commitment
order_review.probe: you got to the very last step and just paused — was there something specific?
order_review.approach: Listen carefully — could be price, fit, or just wanting more time. Match to what she names. If vague, accept gracefully and move to a warm close.

discountCodeFailed.probe: the discount code didn't go through
discountCodeFailed.approach: Acknowledge the frustration. Offer a 10% first-time-customer code that will work. Be apologetic without overdoing it.
